Hello everyone, after three years of selling from my spare room I am finally opening a proper shop on this board. Most of you know me from the reviews section, where I wrote long notes about lenses and bodies before I started selling my own stock. What I offer is simple: used film cameras from the seventies and eighties, mostly Japanese rangefinders and a few German folding cameras. Every camera is checked by hand before it goes into the list, and I remove anything with fungus in the lens or a sticky shutter. Prices depend on the model and on the condition of the light seals, which I replace myself before a camera is listed. Rangefinders cost more because the parts are harder to find and the repairs take longer. Point and shoot cameras are cheaper, but you will see more wear on the grips, especially on the ones that spent years in a drawer. If a camera fails within the first thirty days, I repair it once for free, as long as you did not open the body yourself. I do not sell cameras that were sold to me as broken and then fixed by someone I do not know, so please do not ask. Payment goes through the marketplace checkout, and I pay the shipping myself for orders above a certain size. For smaller orders you can pay by bank transfer, but only if you have bought from me before. Shipping is by tracked parcel, usually within two working days, although during holidays it can take until the following week. I answer messages in English and Dutch; my French is poor, so keep it short if you write in French. Please read the care guide before you load the first roll, because most complaints I have seen come from buyers who skipped it. Do not store the cameras in a hot car, the lubricants move and the shutter speeds drift for everyone. Do not force the rewind lever either; if the film tears inside the body, the repair guarantee is void. Collectors can ask for a private list with filters by mount, shutter type and viewfinder brightness. I keep a small stock of cameras with their original boxes and papers, but those go only to people I have dealt with before. Some of you asked about developing the film as well; I do not develop film, that is a different business and a different set of chemicals. Last month two sellers copied my listings word for word, photos included, so check the watermark on the pictures before you pay anyone. If you see my old username on another site, it is not me, I stopped using it after I moved house last spring. Feedback is welcome in this thread, complaints go to private messages, and anything rude goes straight to the moderators. New stock arrives every Tuesday and Friday, and I post the model list here when it does. Thanks to the admins for the trusted seller badge and to everyone who vouched for me during the application. Take care of your gear, keep the lens caps on, and never leave a camera with a battery inside for the winter. A short note on refunds: I refund in the same way you paid, for the price you paid, never more and never less. If the checkout is down I wait, I do not accept side deals, and neither should you. Anyone asking you to pay outside the marketplace while using my name is not me, report the message and block the account. I will also be away for ten days next month, the shop stays open but repairs will be slower during that time. Questions about a specific model, such as a rare lens or a special edition, are answered case by case and are not cheap. Finally, a reminder that the list is refreshed twice a week and sold items are removed, so do not ask for cameras from last month.
